pages.name: Welcome to The Smoke
pages.html:
THE SMOKE

London. Hackney. You owe money, your phone is cracked and Auntie Pat wants bikes.

The Smoke is an open-world crime game. You start as small-time crew for The Chainring, a bike-theft ring working out of a railway-arch "cycle repair" shop on Morning Lane. Nick bikes, sell them to Pat, keep your head down — or get in a cab, a police car or an ambulance and do the job instead. Every choice moves your Heat.

The roll

Roll your Effort die (normally a d6) + your Stat die + the stat's modifier. Both dice explode: roll the top face and roll it again, adding on. The GM sets a difficulty — Easy, Medium, Hard or Long Shot — and the system turns it into a Target Number from your own dice, so Medium always feels like Medium.

MarginResult
−4 or worseProper Mess — it goes badly wrong
−1 to −3Bad Luck — it fails, and costs you
0Just About — it works, with a catch
+1 to +3Sorted
+4 to +7Smashed It
+8 or moreLegendary

Every die that explodes is a Nice One (1), A Blinder (2), Absolute Scenes (3) or Front Page (4+). The GM adds something good on top.

pages.name: Your Stats
pages.html:
Nine stats, each a die from d4 to d12 (d20 at Rep 5). A new character has one d8, three d6 and five d4.

  • Muscle — lifting, shoving, fighting.
  • Grit — taking a hit, staying up, holding a hose on a fire.
  • Moves — dodging, climbing, running away.
  • Wheels — driving and riding anything. Behind the wheel the vehicle's Performance die replaces your Effort die: a BMX rolls d4, a superbike d12. Handling adds to the roll.
  • Aim — shooting and throwing.
  • Graft — locks, hotwiring, pickpocketing, fixing.
  • Savvy — street smarts, spotting cops, first aid.
  • Front — chat, bluff, intimidation.
  • Bottle — nerve.

Hustle

Spend 1 Hustle to step your Effort die up one size, or 2 Hustle to be On a Roll (dice explode on their top two faces). Hustle comes back after a night at the flat.

Perks

A Perk steps one stat up a die when it applies — Bike Thief for Graft on bike locks, Getaway Driver for Wheels when you are the one being chased.

pages.name: Heat, Wasted & Busted
pages.html:
Seen committing a crime? Your Heat goes up, from ☆ to ★★★★★.

HeatWhat comes
★ClockedPatrols have your description
★★WantedArea cars hunt you
★★★India 99The police helicopter is up — it sees you anywhere outdoors
★★★★TrojansArmed response
★★★★★LockdownRoadblocks on every exit

Losing it: stay out of sight of every police unit and a star drops after 45–150 seconds. A respray at Kwik Spray (Haggerston) or Lea Valley Motors clears it if they did not see you go in; a change of clothes at Ridley Road Market or Westfield takes one star off.

"Stop! Police!" When a unit catches you on foot you can Leg It (Moves), Talk Your Way Out (Front) or Come Quietly.

Wasted: 0 Health and nobody helps → you wake up in Homerton A&E, 10% of your cash lighter. Busted: cuffed → released from Stoke Newington custody, fined 20%, weapons gone. Both clear your Heat.

pages.name: Motors, Nicking & Selling
pages.html:
Get in: walk next to a vehicle, right-click it → Board → choose a seat. The driver moves the vehicle; everyone in it comes too. Drive into an EXIT strip at the edge of a map and right-click → Go to… to cross to the next map.

Nick it: parked cars and chained bikes are locked. Right-click → Nick it rolls Graft against the lock (Easy for a cheap BMX, Long Shot for a supercar). Tools help: bolt cutters (bikes, one band easier), angle grinder (bikes, two bands — but loud), relay box (keyless cars, two bands, silent), slim jim. A Bad Luck or worse with someone watching = Heat.

Carjack: right-click a car someone is driving → Carjack (Muscle or Front). Always +2 Heat.

Sell: bikes, scooters and mopeds to Auntie Pat — ride up to The Arches on Morning Lane and right-click → Sell. Cars and motorbikes to Bow Breakers Yard (Old Ford & Bow). Price depends on the vehicle's value and how battered it is. Hire bikes are worthless; emergency vehicles nobody will touch.

Plates: every car has a London plate. Police ANPR cameras read them — drive a nicked car past a patrol and you are Clocked.

pages.name: Jobs: Taxi, Police, Paramedic, Fire, Courier, Bus
pages.html:
Get in a job vehicle as the driver, right-click it → Start shift. Callouts arrive on your phone (scene controls → phone) and in chat. Accept one and the clock starts.

  • Taxi (black cab or minicab): pull up next to the fare, take them where they are going. Faster = bigger tip. Chat them up (Front) for more.
  • Police (area car, carrier, police bike): ANPR sweep — a stolen car is hidden in the traffic among look-alikes. Target cars and run their plates (right-click your car → ANPR). Find the hit, get behind it with blue lights on, signal it to stop (Front). If it runs, it is a pursuit: roll Wheels each round to close the gap. Then cuff the driver (Muscle), put them in the cage and book them in at a police station. Also pursuits and disturbances. Good police work cools your own Heat.
  • Paramedic: treat and load the patient (Savvy), then blue-light them to Homerton before they slip from Fading to Lost.
  • Fire: get the pump there, then everyone rolls Grit to put it out before it wins.
  • Courier (e-bike, moped, van): collect, deliver, do not crash.
  • Bus: hit every stop on time.

The Chainring: on your phone, Ask Pat for work. She wants particular bikes; Kez texts tip-offs of where they are chained up. Bring them to The Arches.

pages.name: Running The Smoke
pages.html:
GM GUIDE

Setup: scene controls → Street Control → Set up the Hackney starter. It imports Hackney Central, the interiors, the pregens, Pat and the crew, the kit library, and parks a black cab, a police car, an ambulance, a courier e-bike and a BMX on Mare Street.

A GM must be connected: all world changes (traffic, boarding, map crossings, jobs) run on the active GM's client.

Street Control

  • Street Life fills the map players are on with moving traffic (drives on the left, turns at real junctions), parked cars, chained bikes and pedestrians. Densities are in Settings.
  • Auto response sends police units when Heat rises; Units drive lets them hunt along the roads on their own. Turn it off to move them by hand.
  • Pause job clocks when the table needs a breather. Clock speed is a world setting.

Difficulty

Think in bands, not numbers. Easy ≈ 85%, Medium ≈ 60%, Hard ≈ 35%, Long Shot ≈ 12% — solved from the dice the character actually has. Hover a stat on a sheet to see its numbers.

Marking a car as stolen

Select its token and run this as a macro, and police ANPR will flag it: canvas.tokens.controlled[0].document.setFlag('the-smoke','marker',{label:'REPORTED STOLEN',since:'today'})

Damage

Attack = roll vs Guard. Damage = margin + weapon impact − armour. 1–2 minor, 3–4 moderate, 5–6 severe, 7+ critical: the chat card offers the matching Conditions. At 0 Health a character is Down: Grit each round, or Wasted.

Services: police stations at Stoke Newington and Bethnal Green; A&E at Homerton; fire stations at Stoke Newington and Homerton; respray at Kwik Spray (Haggerston) and Lea Valley Motors (Hackney Wick); chop shop at Bow Breakers Yard; clobber at Ridley Road Market and Westfield; Uncle's Café (dealer) in Bethnal Green.

The London Overview scene shows every district: a token on a district can right-click → Travel.

pages.name: Hackney: People
pages.html:
• Auntie Pat (Patricia Okonedo) — runs The Chainring from Pat's Cycle Repairs, Morning Lane arches. Fair, sharp, never forgets.
  • Spanner Rob — her mechanic; strips a stolen bike to parts in eleven minutes.
  • Kez — Pat's nephew on a BMX; scouts bikes and texts tip-offs.
  • Mo Rahman — owns Chicken Palace and your flat. Rent late is fine; police at the door is not.
  • Stretch & the Lea Boys — rival bike crew from across the Marshes in Leyton.
  • DS Harriet Vale — Hackney CID property crime. She has a map with a lot of pins near Morning Lane.

All people, gangs and businesses in The Smoke are fictional. Public services carry parody names (Metro Police, Capital Ambulance, City Fire & Rescue).

pages.name: Mission 1 — On Your Bike
pages.html:
ON YOUR BIKE

Start: Your Flat. Mo bangs on the door: rent is due Friday, and Pat "wants a word".

  1. Walk out through Chicken Palace onto Mare Street and round to The Arches on Morning Lane.
  2. Pat: "Two bikes by tonight. Nothing fancy. Kez'll show you where." (Phone → Ask Pat for work, or the GM hands out the order.)
  3. Kez rides with them to a bike rack — Street Life has chained bikes on every map; the tip-offs are on nearby maps.
  4. Nick two bikes (Graft). Teach the Heat rules the first time someone watches.
  5. Ride them back to The Arches and Sell to Auntie Pat.

Twist: one of the bikes belongs to a Lea Boy. He saw. Next session he wants it back — or Stretch does.

Pay: £40–60 a BMX, more for a mountain bike; order bonus £40.

pages.name: Mission 2 — The Whippet
pages.html:
THE WHIPPET

Pat has a buyer for a Carbon Whippet road bike (worth £1,800 new). The Lycra lot chain them up outside the coffee places on Broadway Market (Haggerston & London Fields) and along the canal.

  • The lock is Hard. Bolt cutters make it Medium; the angle grinder makes it Easy — but loud. Broadway Market on a Saturday is full of phones.
  • If the owner comes back mid-job: Front to bluff ("I'm with the council, mate"), or Moves to leg it down the towpath.
  • Getaway: the Regent's Canal towpath runs west to Haggerston — bikes only, no police cars.

Complication: DS Vale has put a tracker in a bait bike on the same rack (the GM can mark one bike: Savvy, Hard to spot it). Nick the bait and a unit turns up at The Arches next session.

pages.name: Mission 3 — Lights and Sirens
pages.html:
LIGHTS AND SIRENS

The Lea Boys take Pat's van of stripped frames from outside The Arches. Pat wants it back before it crosses the Lea.

  • Steal something fast (or "borrow" the police car parked on Mare Street — +3 Heat if a copper sees).
  • Chase the van east along Morning Lane → Wick Road toward Hackney Wick: use the pursuit rules (Wheels each round, gap 2; 0 = boxed in, 5 = gone).
  • Or the clever route: run ANPR from the stolen area car on every van you pass. The GM can make the scanner flag Pat's van by setting a marker flag on its token (see the GM Guide).

Ending: catch the van on the Hertford Union bridge, face Stretch. Pay off, fight, or grass him to DS Vale (Pat will not like that).
